b:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Application Completeness"}]
c:["$","p",null,{"children":"The single biggest factor in processing speed is whether your application is complete. Missing documents trigger requests for information, which add weeks or months to your timeline."}]
d:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Occupation Demand"}]
e:["$","p",null,{"children":"Some occupations are prioritised based on Australia's labour needs. Healthcare workers, engineers, and IT professionals may see faster processing during periods of high demand."}]

16:["$","p",null,{"children":"Straightforward cases process faster. Complex situations — such as character issues, health concerns, or document discrepancies — take longer to resolve."}]
